generator_cmd: python3 tests/data/script_fixtures/oa_gen.py $TMPDIR/oagen  (stdlib plan writer; corpus swapped)
oracle_cmd: cd $TMPDIR/oagen/swapped && for f in *.plan; do tr '|' '\n' < "$f" | awk -v f="$f" '{i=index($0,"="); print f "\t" substr($0,1,i-1) "\t" substr($0,i+1)}'; done | awk -F'\t' '$2=="steps"{print $1 "\t" $3}' | while IFS=$'\t' read f s; do grep -qxF "$s" gm_steps.txt || echo "$f"; done
